title: Intersectional Fairness in Vision-Language Models for Medical Image Disease Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the 'diagnostic certainty gap' and computing fairness metrics such as Difference in True Positive Rate (ΔTPR), Demographic Parity Difference (DPD), and Difference in Equalised Odds (DEOdds) across composite patient subgroups defined by intersections of age, gender, and race.

Evaluating diagnostic performance (e.g., AUC, false negative rates) and diagnostic confidence on medical images across racial categories, specifically comparing White and Non-White patient subgroups in an ophthalmology dataset.
Evaluating diagnostic performance and fairness metrics on medical images across binary gender categories (male vs. female) within dermatology and ophthalmology datasets.
Evaluating diagnostic performance and fairness metrics on medical images across distinct clinical age brackets (e.g., 0-40, 41-60, and 60+ years).
